scope: Actual generated images visually inspected against retained official references. Eleven four-view images, nine independent dimension-photo overlays and eight exact-option overlays. This is geometry/source review, not browser DOM/WebGL, firmware execution, calibrated material measurement, physical fit or hardware acceptance.
historicalEvidencePolicy: Earlier batch-04 images and old model hashes are not reused as acceptance of these new artifacts.

independentReview.scope: A second visual inspection of N16R8-M, N32R16V, N32R16V-M, N16R8-UM and Zero-N8R8-M exact overlays.
independentReview.finding: Four DevKit overlays showed no mirror or coarse placement issue. The Zero image-size/occluded-anchor issue was corrected, and new images were generated.
